verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a REST API reference for building integrations and automating workflows, and a GraphQL API with flexible queries, so an API reference clearly exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at the usual docs paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive explorer or try-it console, runnable code examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
